summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into his first Singapore Grand Prix victory, finishing ahead of Charles Leclerc after George Russell's early crash eliminated the Mercedes threat. Hamilton's strategy miscalculation proved costly for Ferrari's championship hopes, prompting an apology to his team as the error rippled through the standings. Kimi Antonelli now stands on the brink of clinching the world title at Austin, with Verstappen's resurgence offering a final challenge to McLaren's championship credentials.
